_comment: #350 player_room_loop's start (FIXTURE-FIRST). Stands in the inn's upper hall at (3,2) facing UP into hallway_door_a -- the shut door the room register leases -- so the run opens on the gate's NEGATIVE arm before a coin is spent. visited_own_room is banked (the stairs' own on_enter_accomplishment) because that is the lease option's hidden gate; resolved_wrong_order is deliberately ABSENT so the register renders exactly two rows (the locked lease, the rates exit) and the option-array pins stay crisp. gold 19 is one short of the 20g lease on purpose: the script earns the last coin off the laden tray, which banks delivered_item and nothing class-shaped ([Helper] gains on cleaned_the_inn, not delivered_item). warrior 2 is the near_room_upgrade build (gained_by sparred_with_relc, L2 requires won_combat 1, L3 wants melee_hit 6 which is 0 here, so the sleep in the new room stays quiet). `observe` is the QA-fixture-only grant the Invrisil interiors already establish. rng_state is seed 9's derived state (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd); no fight resolves here, so it is inert.
